# awx_notification_template (Resource)

Manages an AWX notification template through `/api/v2/notification_templates/`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "awx_notification_template" "demo_webhook_notification" {
  name              = "Demo Webhook Notification"
  notification_type = "webhook"
  organization      = awx_organization.demo_organization.id
  notification_configuration = jsonencode({
    "url"                      = "http://example.com"
    "http_method"              = "POST"
    "disable_ssl_verification" = true
    "username"                 = ""
    "password"                 = ""
    "headers"                  = {}
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of this notification template.
- `notification_type` (String) Notification type
- `organization` (Number) Organization

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description of this notification template.
- `messages` (String) Optional custom messages for notification template.
- `notification_configuration` (String) Notification configuration

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Database ID for this notification template.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# The import ID is <id>
import {
  to = awx_notification_template.example
  id = "1"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is <id>
terraform import awx_notification_template.example 1
```
